title: Overreaction to volatility shock and option returns
idea: Identify days with a large one‑day jump in 30‑day ATM IV (e.g., >2 σ) and test whether options (especially out‑of‑the‑money calls/puts) earn abnormal returns in the following 5‑10 days, controlling for delta and gamma exposure.

title: Essays in financial economics
idea: When VIX futures term structure is steep (high term ratio) and the daily ETF net asset change is positive (using the ETF AUM series if available), go short the front‑month VIX future and long the next‑month future (a short‑both spread) to capture the leverage‑rebalancing premium.
